title: Billing DB Filesystem Exhaustion
root_cause: Archived redo/log files filled the billing database filesystem, causing DB write failures and downstream transaction timeouts.
root_cause_tr: Billing DB filesystemi arsiv loglari nedeniyle doldu; DB write fail sonrasinda billing, charging, payment ve order servislerinde timeout/txn_fail olustu.
resolution_action: Eski archive loglar temizlendi, filesystem genisletildi ve billing DB write islemleri dogrulandi.
lessons_learned: disk_full sinyali downstream transaction alarmlarindan once geliyorsa root cause skoru DB/storage tarafina yukseltilmelidir.
